<plan>Start by collecting the stone in front with a Do action. Then walk two steps south‑west onto the path and continue one more step to reach the tree, face it and Do to harvest wood. Next, move one step north and three steps west to stand in front of the skeleton; Do to defeat it (collect Sampling). After that, return to the cow by moving one step south‑east and Do to eat it (Collect Cow). Return to the original spot, face west again and Do to collect the coal. With stone, wood, and coal in inventory, craft a table (Make Table), then place the stone in front of the table (Place Stone) and place the table (Place Table) to satisfy those achievements. Use the table to craft a wood pickaxe (Make Wood Pickaxe) and a wood sword (Make Wood Sword). Use the pickaxe to mine the coal ore we've already collected. Finally, craft and use an iron pickaxe with the furnace you can build from remaining materials to mine a diamond for Collect Diamond. This plan yields all achievable achievements from the current location; remaining achievements that require additional entities (zombie, lake, iron ore) can be pursued when encountered elsewhere. After completing these steps, sleep if energy drops below maximum.>
